description: Set (url) or clear (url: null) the webhook for a quiz. Completed responses POST to the url; with a secret, requests carry an X-QuizGen-Signature HMAC-SHA256 header.

quiz_id.description: Quiz id (the `id` field returned by create_quiz/list_quizzes).

url.description: https:// URL to receive completed responses, or null to clear.

name: set_webhook
title: Set Webhook
